observation: Actually inspected both complete native/control sheets and the three-way close-up. Hardened held block, material, five tools and held armor sprites have visible emission removed by the alpha-zero control. Each worn armor piece emits independently, retaining recognizable helmet outline, chest pattern, leggings pattern or boot trim. The Hardened block face is brighter than ordinary Glowstone and its unchanged diffuse alpha-zero control; its simple yellow center and border remain recognizable. All four required range assertions are retained in authenticated matching companion-on evidence.
